name: vortex
title: Vortex
description: A slow spiral of colour fading toward the edges.

accessibility: The effect layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only children are exposed.
Spinning spirals can cause vestibular discomfort: keep `speed` slow and offer a pause control.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand (wire it to a visible control if it runs behind reading content).
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) stops the spin.
